clue.text: Far tremor shakes to change planet

indicators.note: shakes says the letters of the two words are jolted into a new order

explanation.surface: A distant earthquake is enough to alter a whole world.
explanation.definitionFit: To terraform is to reshape another world so that it resembles Earth and can support life.

indicators.note: half of the word for the number keeps only its first three of six letters

parts.note: 30 written as a word is thirty

indicators.note: a quarter of the four-letter number word keeps just its first letter

parts.note: 9 written as a word is nine
K stands for a thousand, as in 10K

explanation.surface: A garbled arithmetic sum that the writer finds dubious.
explanation.walkthrough: The numbers must be spelt out before cutting: thirty halved leaves THI, nine quartered leaves N.
explanation.definitionFit: To suspect something is to believe or think it likely without proof.

clue.text: Break and rend in half with vengeance

indicators.note: in half says only the front half of the word rend is kept

parts.note: spite is a desire to hurt, close to vengeance

explanation.surface: Someone tears something in two out of revenge.
explanation.definitionFit: A respite is a short break or pause from something unpleasant.

clue.text: Within acting, no man is shown up

indicators.note: shown up says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An actor's company where no man appears on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link; in a down clue 'shown up' reverses the run GNOMA buried in 'acting, no man'.
explanation.definitionFit: Among and within both mean in the midst of or included in a group.

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
an era is a period of time
an era is a period of time
Echo is the radio alphabet word for E

explanation.surface: A repetitive list that ends with a shout bouncing back.
explanation.definitionFit: To operate is to work or function, as a machine does.

parts.note: suggests stuff that is not politically correct, but means the Apple computer that is not a PC, sounding like the waterproof rubberised cloth

explanation.surface: Content that might offend modern sensibilities.
explanation.walkthrough: Charles Macintosh patented the waterproof cloth; Apple's Macintosh is the classic rival to the PC.
explanation.definitionFit: Macintosh names both Apple's non-PC computer and the waterproof rubberised fabric used for raincoats.
Jobs are posts of employment, and Steve Jobs was the co-founder of Apple Computer.

clue.text: Jack lost set again, beginning to expect small crowds

parts.note: J is the abbreviation for jack in a pack of cards

indicators.note: set again says the letters of lost are rearranged
beginning to picks out the opening letter of expect

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing sizes

explanation.surface: A card player who lost a set expects to be mobbed.
explanation.definitionFit: To jostle is to push and shove, as crowds do, so crowds as a verb fits.

clue.text: Dancer's dance with energy produced rain

parts.note: a ball is a formal dance
E is the physics symbol for energy

indicators.note: produced suggests the letters of rain are reworked into something new

explanation.surface: A rain dance performed energetically actually brought on a downpour.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Dancer's' stands for 'is', joining the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballerina is a female ballet dancer.

parts.note: miss is a word for a girl or young woman
P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs
OK means fine
'e is a dropped-aitch he, leaving just the letter e

explanation.surface: Someone quotes a headline about a young woman's parking ticket, with a Cockney twist.
explanation.definitionFit: To misspeak is to say something wrongly, so misspoke means said incorrectly.

clue.text: Disastrous company model installed in secret

indicators.note: installed in says one piece is placed inside another

parts.note: sly means secretive or furtive
the Model T was Ford's famous car

explanation.surface: A firm secretly fits a new model, with dire results.
explanation.walkthrough: The Model T Ford gives T, set inside SLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Something disastrous is costly in its damaging consequences.

indicators.note: covering says the first piece wraps around the next

parts.note: a skin is a thin film, as on custard
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A movie about a decent athletic pursuit.
explanation.definitionFit: Skiing is a winter sport of gliding over snow.

clue.text: Woman was in charge after union left (or was abolished)

indicators.note: after places the led piece behind the letters for union and left

parts.note: Ann is a woman's name
led means was in charge

explanation.surface: A woman took over the leadership after the union walked out.
explanation.definitionFit: Annulled means cancelled or declared void, as an abolished law or marriage is.

clue.text: Bill raved about the end of Microsoft

indicators.note: about signals the letters of raved are moved around
the end of picks the final letter of Microsoft

explanation.surface: Bill Gates ranted about the demise of his company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like Bill Gates of Microsoft, but it is a bill posted up as an advertisement.
explanation.definitionFit: A bill is a printed notice or poster, a form of advertisement.

definitions.meaning: unlike means not the same as
another can mean a separate or distinct one

explanation.definitionFit: Different means dissimilar, and also separate or other, as in a different day.

indicators.note: Spooner's says the opening sounds of two words are swapped

parts.note: a poodle is a breed of dog
a tip is an end, as of a finger

explanation.surface: A goodbye to the remains of a cigarette.
explanation.walkthrough: A dog-end is British slang for a cigarette butt; Spooner swaps POODLE TIP into TOODLE PIP.
explanation.definitionFit: Toodle-pip is a dated British way of saying goodbye, like so long.

clue.text: Posh one wearing stone-washed shirt as uniform

indicators.note: wearing says the posh one is wrapped inside the garment letters
washed says the letters of stone are churned up

parts.note: T as in T-shirt
U means upper class, posh
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A toff dresses in faded denim as a sort of uniform.
explanation.walkthrough: An Eton suit is the traditional uniform of Eton, the English public school; 'washed' rearranges STONE to ETONS.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eton suit is the formal uniform once worn by boys at Eton College.

clue.text: Kills hero at sea, away from land

parts.note: offs is slang for kills

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters of hero are rearranged

explanation.surface: A hero is slain out on the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: Offshore means situated at sea some distance from the coast.

clue.text: This jellyfish was into mushy peas

indicators.note: into says one word goes inside another
mushy says the letters of peas are mashed up

explanation.surface: A jellyfish turned up in a bowl of mushy peas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'This' is a link pointing at the definition; WAS sits inside SEAP from the shuffled peas. Mushy peas are a British side dish.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea wasp is a box jellyfish with a highly venomous sting.

definitions.meaning: fast as in a fast train, one making few stops
show means display or convey, as with feelings

explanation.surface: A nod to a British TV sketch comedy.
explanation.walkthrough: The Fast Show was a British TV sketch comedy of the 1990s.
explanation.definitionFit: An express is a fast train or delivery, and to express is to show or convey.

parts.note: to hit is to punch
ma is a familiar word for mother

explanation.surface: Someone urges a boxer named Hatton not to strike his mother.
explanation.walkthrough: Ricky Hatton, the British boxer, was nicknamed The Hitman.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hitman was the ring nickname of British boxing champion Ricky Hatton.

indicators.note: cycling suggests the letters of outside are spun round into a new order

explanation.surface: Riding a bike outdoors is boring.
explanation.definitionFit: Tedious means tiresome and boring, much the same as dull.

definitions.meaning: a measure of computer processing speed

explanation.surface: A computer chip turns out to be a disaster.
explanation.definitionFit: A megaflop is a million floating-point operations per second, a computing unit, and also a colossal failure.

indicators.note: after places the word it's behind the letter for diamonds

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
D is the abbreviation for diamonds in card games

explanation.surface: Someone checks whether gold is worth more than diamonds.
explanation.definitionFit: To audit accounts is to examine or inspect them officially.

indicators.note: swallowed says one piece is taken inside another

parts.note: ale is a drink
pp, pianissimo, is the music marking for very quietly

explanation.surface: A fruity drink sipped silently.
explanation.definitionFit: An apple is a common tree fruit.

clue.text: Gang finally caught over botched raid

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of caught
botched means the letters of raid are messed up

explanation.surface: A gang is at last caught after a failed raid.
explanation.definitionFit: A triad is a Chinese criminal gang.

clue.text: After endless wine, perhaps Dracula's given up anger to modernise

indicators.note: After places the shortened monster behind the shortened wine
endless says the last letter of the wine is cut off

parts.note: red is an example of wine

indicators.note: given up says the anger is removed from the monster's name

parts.note: Dracula is the most famous vampire
ire is anger

explanation.surface: Having drunk most of the wine, Dracula calms down and moves with the times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dracula's given up' means Dracula has given up: the monster's full title loses the word for anger, and 'endless' clips the wine; 'After' puts the monster second.
explanation.definitionFit: To revamp something is to renovate or update it.

indicators.note: sounds says the words are spoken to give the letters entered

parts.note: a ewe is a sheep, a quartet is four, and an ear is an organ

explanation.surface: Four sheep play the organ and the music is heavenly.
explanation.walkthrough: Said aloud, EWE FOUR EAR runs together into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Euphoria is a state of intense happiness, close to bliss.

indicators.note: capsizing turns the word for vessels upside down, read backwards

parts.note: pots are vessels

explanation.surface: Stop the boats from overturning.
explanation.definitionFit: To stop something happening is to prevent it.

parts.note: reads as a company buy-out, but describes being in a state of owning, or being seized by a spirit

explanation.surface: A firm has been bought out.
explanation.definitionFit: Possessed means owned, and also taken over by a demon or spirit.
